description:
Trump's USDA wants to roll back safety rules for meat processing workers.

The new rule would eliminate maximum line speeds in pork plants, risking worker and food safety.

This comes after Pilgrim's Pride and other Big Ag companies donated millions to Trump's inauguration and ballroom.

Producer/Editor: Zach Ben-Amots
Co-producer: Katie Nixdorf
Videographer: William Harrah
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: One of the Most Dangerous Jobs in America Is About To Get EVEN WORSE
